scientific_anchor.dataset_title: M. cinxia and C. melitaearum in the Åland metapopulation system
scientific_anchor.published_scope: 1993-2017; circa 4000 dry-meadow habitat patches; autumn patch surveys plus spring revisits
scientific_anchor.window_reason: A published analysis of this public metapopulation explicitly restricts to 2000-2017 after the comprehensive 1998-1999 habitat remapping; this window was frozen before any locality-visit outcome rows were opened.
scientific_anchor.source_process_claim: conditional internal-source metapopulation explanation within the published Aland merged patch registry; no claim that biological immigration from outside the declared source universe is impossible

dictionary_derived_patch_registry_contra.node_id_semantics: PatchID; merged patch identities are used to keep long-term patch IDs consistent after historical patch mergers.
dictionary_derived_patch_registry_contra.geometry_semantics: Most recent WKT polygon recorded for the merged patch; used only as registry geometry evidence, not as an outcome.
dictionary_derived_patch_registry_contra.distance_metric: Euclidean metres on frozen patch centroids
dictionary_derived_patch_registry_contra.static_world_geometry_rule: Use the response-independent merged-patch centroid coordinates in Patches final.csv for all structural worlds. Do not use Locality Visit GeometryUpdated/Centroid_X/Centroid_Y after response access to redesign worlds.

dictionary_derived_response_semantics.dataset_prefix_rule: AF prefix only; AF denotes Aland fall survey. AS spring and CS Cotesia rows are outside the endpoint rather than negative outcomes.
dictionary_derived_response_semantics.outcome_definition: Binary fall occupancy/detection endpoint: event if Nest Total > 0; non-event if Nest Total == 0. Nest Total is the total M. cinxia nests found during the normal survey.
dictionary_derived_response_semantics.extra_survey_reason: The variable dictionary states later extra effort was added for some genotyping years but the normal survey was always performed with the original search effort for comparability. Therefore the endpoint uses normal-survey Nest Total only.
